name: Pedraza (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and white, charged with five light blue five-pointed stars and the inscription MUNICIPIO DE PEDRAZA in white arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Pedraza, a municipality in the department of Magdalena, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: five stars, one large at the centre
inscription MUNICIPIO DE PEDRAZA arched above
